Low Sugar, High Taste Keto Bars

When we committed to a low sugar lifestyle, we were shocked by the amount of sugar in packaged foods, especially chewy granola bars. Wildly delicious with 1 gram of sugar, you'll never guess these soft granola bars are low in sugar! - Michelle & Toby, Munk Pack Co-Founders.

Snack Back Against Sugar™

Like the chipMUNK, we're always on the hunt for the most nutritious, tastiest ingredients for our keto food and gluten free snacks. Recognizing that health journeys can be challenging, we keep it simple, wholesome, low in sugar, and wildly delicious. Join the PACK and snack back against sugar™ with Munk Pack. Our keto friendly snacks are designed to support your healthy lifestyle without compromising on taste.

Taking Down Sugar, With Keto Granola Bars

Our mission is to put sugar out of commission. These gluten free granola bars contain only 1 gram of sugar from naturally occurring sugars in nuts and seeds. We use allulose for sweetness, avoiding erythritol's aftertaste and cooling effect. Our low glycemic, low sugar granola bars satisfy your sweet tooth without causing a sugar rush, making them perfect for anyone mindful of their sugar intake.

Our Sweet Spot: Wildly Delicious 1g Sugar Snacks

Enjoy the perfect combination of chocolate and almond butter in our Almond Butter Chocolate Chip Granola Bars. At 150 calories, it's the ideal keto snack or low carb snack to fuel your healthy lifestyle. Made with a wholesome mix of nuts and seeds, our gluten free bars deliver all the goodness of a chewy granola bar, but without grains. Each bar contains 2g of net carbs, calculated as Total Carb (13g) - Fiber (5g) - Allulose (5.5g) - Glycerin (0.5g).

Just add water, cook and enjoy! Though new to shelves, Pearl Milling Company has been a part of our story for over 130 years. Pearl Milling Company was a small mill in the bustling town of St. Joseph, Missouri. Using a pearl milling technique, they produced flour, cornmeal, and, beginning in 1889, the famous self-rising pancake mix that would go on to be known as Aunt Jemima. Our pancakes have been bringing smiles to the breakfast table ever since. Last June, PepsiCo and The Quaker Oats Company made a commitment to change the name and image of Aunt Jemima, recognizing that they do not reflect our core values. As part of its rebranding journey, Pearl Milling Company set out to fulfill two promises: to continue delivering the same great-tasting products families have enjoyed for over a century and to inspire moments that matter around the breakfast table and in communities. With a commitment to community impact, the brand developed P.E.A.R.L. Pledge (Prosperity, Empowerment, Access, Representation and Leadership) as a platform to help address societal barriers faced by Black women and girls. Recognizing the importance of Black women in the brand's history, P.E.A.R.L. Pledge will focus on providing funding to organizations helping to meet the significant needs facing Black women and girls today, such as gaps in food security and inadequate access to financial and educational resources.

Our Ingredients - Healthy Indulgence

Raw Sprouted Organic Almonds - Soaked in pink himalayan salt crystals and dehydrated at a low temperature to insure the nutritional integrity/improve the digestion of the almonds. Soaking also reduces the phytic acid, a substance that reduces your ability to absorb minerals. Sourced from California and Turkey.

Raw Red Maca (ma-kuh) - This root vegetable is native to the high Andes of Bolivia and Peru. It has an earthy, nutty taste with a slight hint of butterscotch. Maca has been used as a source of nourishment and healing for milleniums; and has long been used to increase stamina, boost libido, and combat fatigue, for many good reasons. The root is a superb adaptogen, as it enables the body to more easily adjust to and regulate stress factors imposed upon it.

Cinnamon - A small tree that grows in India, Sri Lanka, Indonesia, Brazil, Vietnam, and Egypt. In Ayurveda, cinnamon is used as a remedy for diabetes, indigestion, and colds.

Coconut Palm Sugar - Coconut palm sugar is made from the sweet nectar of the coconut tree flower blossoms, coconut palm sugar is a pure and simple low-glycerinic sweetener that provides the energy and mineral rich nutrition your body needs.

short_description: Our story begins in 1919. That?s when the world was introduced to what you now know as the Hostess CupCake. It?s perhaps the first and most significant moment in the history of snack cakes. Just ask your great grandpappy. He was there. Six years later, Continental Baking wanted to add a line of cakes to sell alongside a hot little item they were making called Wonder bread. This new line of sweet treats became known as Hostess. And a brand was born. Continental hit the sponge cake gold mine in 1930 when Jimmy Dewar invented Twinkies. At two for a nickel, popularity skyrocketed and it soon became Hostess? best-selling snack cake. Twinkies have since become an American icon. Half a billion are made each year. That?s a lot of creme filling! In the summer of 1995, Interstate Bakeries Corporation acquired Continental Baking Company. This made Interstate the largest wholesale baker of fresh delivered bread and cake in the United States. In 2009, Interstate changed its name to Hostess Brands, Inc., to better reflect our beloved brands. Fast forward to present day, and we?re continuing to turn everyday moments into small celebrations with a variety of new and classic treats like Ding Dongs, Ho Hos and Donettes, just to name a few. You can visit our products page to learn more about our delectable line of snack cake deliciousness. But please don?t ask us to pick a favorite.

short_description: At Tina’s we believe everyone should have the choice of the best tasting burrito and not have to pay more for it. Tina’s Big Chimichanga Spicy Beef and Bean is a budget friendly, flavor-packed, protein filled burrito. This 8 oz chimichanga is loaded with 17 grams of protein, iron and fiber giving our burrito the edge in taste and value! Easy to share or eat as one serving (We certainly won’t judge). Our Big Chimichangas are hand crafted using a fresh baked tortilla and a meaty, hearty filling to help satisfy our hungry customers on the go! We believe our Burritos are great for any occasion. Our individually wrapped burritos are easy to cook and can satisfy your comfort food cravings as a quick snack or low cost, kid friendly meals. Tina’s prepackaged microwave burritos can be cooked from thawed or keep them in the freezer for later enjoyment. Also try them in the air fryer or bake in the oven and pair them with your favorite burrito toppings! We love adding sour cream, cheddar cheese or fresh cilantro. Make it a meal worthy of sharing with others by adding a side of Mexican rice or tortilla chips with a fire roasted salsa! Don’t forget the Mexican ice cream for dessert! Use a little creativity by making a burrito casserole or adding suiza sauce. Ready to try something new? Check out our new Pizza Burrito!

product_name: Delimex White Meat Chicken Corn Taquitos Frozen Snacks & Appetizers, 20 Ct Box Full Size, 20 oz
short_description: Taste the tradition of authentic, street-style Mexican flavors with Delimex White Meat Chicken Taquitos. Oscar Ancira Sr. founded Delimex in 1984, using Mexican-inspired ingredients and traditional recipes to recreate the savory taste of street-style taco shops. Our frozen taquitos are made with tender white meat chicken, seasoned with cumin and ancho chilies and wrapped in a crispy corn tortilla. Delimex taquitos can be prepared in the microwave, oven or air fryer, and are ready in minutes. Enjoy our taquitos as an appetizer, snack or part of your dinner, served with salsa, guacamole and sour cream. short_description: 1 lb freeze-dried açaí powder for drinks, smoothies and fruit bowls. SLOFOODGROUP's freeze-dried acai powder is made by freeze-drying the açaí berry, removing all moisture, and grinding into a fine powder to preserve the delicate flavor profile of this Amazonian fruit. What does açaí taste like? This fleshy little fruit is often described as having a similar flavor to both raspberries and pomegranates, but earthier, less sweet, and similar notes to those found in cacao. How to use freeze-dried açaí in your fruit bowls and smoothies? Freeze-dried açaí can be easily added to shakes, smoothies, and fruit bowls by simply mixing in water or adding alongside other ingredients during the blending process. We suggest starting with 1-2 tablespoons per eight-ounce serving and adjusting to fit your specific taste preferences.Often times, açaí is also sweetened with sugar, honey, or traditionally guarana, but we personally enjoy letting the other fruits naturally lend their sweetness to the final product rather than adding additional sugars. Ours is 100% real Açaí powder with no fillers. Try for yourself in fruit bowls, smoothies, and more.
